     3	This ledger maps labels of the manuscript on the second moment of the
     4	Stratonovich hyperbolic Anderson model with Gaussian noise fractional in time
     5	to the Lean declarations in this package. Labels refer to the manuscript
     6	revision ba01d98 and are written exactly as in its LaTeX source (for
     7	example `P:clock-copy-obstruction`). The ledger was written and reviewed
     8	at the earlier revisions cf979d6 and 669ccc9. The later revisions changed
     9	only prose, titles, the literature review, layout and figures: every cited
    10	label exists in all three, and the mathematical expressions of each cited
    11	statement and its proof are the same up to whitespace and braces (script
    12	checks recorded in `provenance/manuscript-anchor.json`).

    14	## Scope
    15	
    16	- The "What it states" column is a faithful paraphrase, sometimes
    17	  shortened. The exact statement is the Lean type in
    18	  `StratonovichHAMAudit/<Module>.lean`; `Audit/<module>/` prints the
    19	  elaborated types.
    20	- The rows cover every public theorem (104) and the 13 definitions whose
    21	  values are stated as facts. The other 37 public definitions (for example
    22	  `kappa`, `delta`, `gauge`, `counts`) only name quantities used in those
    23	  statements and have no rows of their own; read their bodies in the Lean
    24	  source or in `Audit/`.
    25	- The `StratonovichHAMAudit` modules check finite, algebraic and scalar
    26	  steps only: exact identities, polynomial and rational certificates,
    27	  real-power bookkeeping, parameter ranges, and a few finite-dimensional
    28	  inner-product and finite-word facts.
    29	- The five `StratonovichHAMSecondMoment` modules (sections marked "whole
    30	  result" below) formalize the conclusions of five labelled results in full,
    31	  in three ways. `L:gaussian-scalar-powers` is stated with the manuscript's
    32	  own hypotheses. `L:gram-scalar-algebra` and `L:tube-rayleigh-tail` are
    33	  proved under weaker hypotheses (no completeness or `C_ij >= 0`; no
    34	  `delta < 1`) and also stated exactly as the manuscript does by the
    35	  wrappers `gram_scalar_algebra_paper` and `rayleigh_tail_paper`; the
    36	  Rayleigh lemma's "In particular" application to another proposition is
    37	  not formalized. `E:kappa` and `E:driver-parameters` are proved from the
    38	  numerical part of `H:homog` (a generalization) and also restated under
    39	  the full hypothesis `H:homog`, which `HomogHypothesis.HomogCovariance`
    40	  models clause by clause (covariance measure, spectral measure, evenness,
    41	  temperedness, positive-definiteness, scaling, parameter ranges). Side conditions the TeX
    42	  leaves implicit (a probability measure, integrability, measurability)
    43	  are explicit hypotheses, and integrability is part of each integral
    44	  conclusion.
    45	- The SPDE itself, stochastic integrals, Gaussian measures, Fourier and
    46	  spectral analysis, operator theory and all limits in time or in a
    47	  regularization are outside Lean. Where a Lean statement needs an analytic
    48	  fact about the model, that fact enters as an explicit hypothesis of the
    49	  theorem (a "supplied hypothesis" below). Lean checks the deduction from
    50	  those hypotheses, not the hypotheses themselves.
    51	- A successful `lake build` is not a verification receipt for the
    52	  manuscript. It shows that the stated Lean theorems are proved from their
    53	  hypotheses; whether a statement matches the manuscript step it is listed
    54	  against is a separate, human judgment recorded in this ledger.
    55	- Three further modules developed alongside these (normalized Gaussian
    56	  coordinates, vector Gaussian projection, and colored vector words) are
    57	  withheld from this package because they depend on a library that is not
    58	  yet public.
    59	- "no direct label" means the declaration checks a computation from the
    60	  development of the manuscript that does not appear as, or inside, a
    61	  labeled statement of the revision cited above. Such rows make no claim
    62	  about the manuscript.

   164	## DimensionalMatrix
   165	
   166	Defines the backward, coupling and forward 2x2 phase matrices of a single
   167	interaction and computes their product with all four entries retained, in
   168	unweighted coordinates. At fixed frequencies `r`, `rho` the matrices are
   169	the factors of `S(-t) B(b) S(t)` in `E:variance-physical-adjoint` of
   170	`P:actual-wave-form` (`backward` = `S(-t)`, `coupling` = the force
   171	`B(b)(u, v) = (0, b u)`, `forward` = `S(t)`, with `cp = cos(rt)`,
   172	`sp/p = sin(rt)/r` and the coefficient `H` in place of `b`), and
   173	`full_interaction` is that unweighted product. It is not yet the normalized
   174	kernel `E:variance-normalized-kernel`: there `b_r = <r> sin(rt)/r`
   175	(`L:masked-continuous-wave`), and passing to it needs the Bessel-weighted
   176	change of coordinates on the phase space `E` together with the weight
   177	`1/sqrt(<xi><eta>)`. That conversion, the Fourier interpretation and the
   178	zero-frequency case (where the manuscript uses the continuous sine quotient)
   179	are outside Lean. The free matrix also appears in the proof of
   180	`L:complex-phase` and, in balanced coordinates, as `W_t` in
   181	`L:symplectic-free`, which also defines the force `B(b)`.
